what_to_look_for: Anything before 2024-09-09 is a pre-event baseline and is the single most valuable acquisition for this event. 2024-09-09 to 09-30 is during the flood; take it if it exists at all. October is early post-event.

Clear season. Best chance of low cloud for verifying the 42 candidate facilities and the road and bridge segments. Favour Nov to Jan; February onward brings biomass-burning haze that degrades imagery without always being logged as cloud.
Brackets the November 2025 flood. Partial cloud is acceptable here; Sentinel-2 showed roughly 60 percent of the area visible on 2025-12-03, so a usable flood-period scene is plausible.
First reliably clear period after the event. March and April were the clearest months measured.
The 2024 Chao Phraya flood season. This is the one area where near-clear imagery during a flood is confirmed to exist; Sentinel-2 measured 6.5 percent cloud over this area on 2024-11-11.
Central plain dry season. Clear acquisitions are near certain if any scene exists.
